description: This file provides utility functions for handling date parameters, including normalization to ISO strings and merging date range parameters with other query parameters, supporting legacy keys.

methods.name: toDateParamStrings
methods.description: Converts date inputs into ISO string parameters, handling undefined and invalid inputs to prevent backend parsing issues.

methods.name: withDateParams
methods.description: Merges existing query parameters with normalized date range parameters, supporting legacy 'from'/'to' keys and explicit 'startDate'/'endDate'.
